answer: One enforceable rule: force a unique proof-of-place stamp per epoch that cannot be replayed by siblings. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by converting a one-time spend into a recurring per-account bill, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. An identity earns only when its ocean recurs, its oasis survives audit, and a nectar from an unlinked peer confirms it.
